# evroc_public_ip (Resource)

Provides an evroc public IP address resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the public IP. Must be unique within the project.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project this resource belongs to. Defaults to the provider project.
- `region` (String) Region where the public IP is allocated. Defaults to provider region.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `user_labels` (Map of String) User-defined labels (key/value pairs) for organizing and selecting resources.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the public IP was created (RFC3339 format).
- `fqid` (String) Fully qualified resource ID (FQID). Use this to reference this resource from other resources.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ip_address` (String) The allocated IPv4 address.
- `ip_id` (String) Unique identifier (UUID) of the public IP.
- `system_labels` (Map of String) System-managed labels automatically set by evroc (read-only).
